title: MRFoundry: Knowledge-guided agent loops for end-to-end MRI research
abstract: arXiv:2611.13289v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents can write code, use scientific software, and revise computational workflows, opening new possibilities for MRI research. Effective assistance requires connecting acquisition physics, data conventions, specialized tools, and scientific validation. We present MRFoundry, an open-source, extensible package that connects MRI knowledge to agent actions and output checks. Project-local memory preserves decisions and evidence, while reviewed contributions allow researchers to improve shared guidance. Researcher-supervised examples demonstrate skill-guided sequence auditing and acquired-data reconstruction, connecting tool use, output checks, and documented decisions. Alongside MRFoundry, we introduce MRI Agent Bench to compare agents with and without the package across models and MRI task domains. translated_title: MRFoundry：面向端到端MRI研究的知识引导智能体循环
translated_abstract: 人工智能智能体能够编写代码、使用科学软件并修改计算工作流，为MRI研究开辟了新的可能性。有效的辅助需要将采集物理、数据规范、专用工具和科学验证连接起来。我们提出了MRFoundry，这是一个开源、可扩展的软件包，将MRI知识与智能体行为及输出检查相连接。项目本地记忆可保存决策与证据，而经过审核的贡献允许研究人员改进共享指导。由研究人员监督的示例展示了技能引导的序列审核和采集数据重建，将工具使用、输出检查和记录的决策串联起来。与MRFoundry一同，我们提出了MRI Agent Bench，用于在不同模型和MRI任务领域中比较有和没有该软件包的智能体表现。在涵盖24种任务类型和十个模型的240项配对核心评估中，全部检查通过的完成率从没有MRFoundry时的67.5%（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MRFoundry是一个开源、可扩展的知识引导智能体框架，将MRI专业知识与智能体行为和输出验证相连接，并配套推出MRI Agent Bench基准测试，显著提升了AI智能体完成端到端MRI研究任务的成功率。
en_tdlr: MRFoundry is an open-source, extensible knowledge-guided agent framework that connects MRI expertise to agent actions and output checks, and its accompanying MRI Agent Bench benchmark substantially improves AI agents' success on end-to-end MRI research tasks.
